optionLength.primaryFlagDefinition: correct option more than 8 characters above distractor median or total spread above 15 characters

sourceIdFallbackMismatches.note: The explicit sourceId values are valid, but sourceIdForQuestion() still returns older broad IDs for these records.

highConfidenceFindings.finding: Each ten-question block repeats one conceptual stem and the same option set, changing only a superficial scenario prefix and option order.
highConfidenceFindings.action: Replace or substantially rewrite most variants so different questions test different facts, decisions, or scenarios; retain at most a small deliberate set per concept.

highConfidenceFindings.finding: The correct option is strictly the longest in 44.0% of these 300 questions, above the stated below-35% target, although no individual question crosses the primary 8-character-median or 15-character-spread flag.
highConfidenceFindings.action: Run a targeted second-pass review of the strictly-longest items and rebalance only when content permits; do not pad distractors or rewrite sound options mechanically.

highConfidenceFindings.finding: sourceIdForQuestion() does not reproduce the explicit granular source IDs currently stored in the retained files and falls back to older broad IDs.
highConfidenceFindings.action: Update the helper with the approved granular mappings or make explicit per-question source IDs the sole generation path and add a regression check.

highConfidenceFindings.finding: Three source entries used by the audited questions have no chapter, page, section, or equivalent locator in the catalog.
highConfidenceFindings.action: Add inspected locators to each source entry so the answer and explanation can be traced beyond a broad title and scope.

highConfidenceFindings.finding: The current source world-physiotherapy-ebp-2023 is catalogued only for evidence quality, uncertainty, and clinical reasoning, while these items assert professional ethics claims about welfare, privacy, autonomy, and informed choice.
highConfidenceFindings.action: Add a source locator that directly supports these ethics claims or assign a more specific inspected professional-ethics source.

highConfidenceFindings.finding: The technology source note still says no new source IDs are required, but the current catalog and provenance remediation manifest add and use granular source IDs.
highConfidenceFindings.action: Update the note to list the current source IDs and their ranges, or mark the sentence as historical.

highConfidenceFindings.finding: The coverage manifest records group and subtopic counts but does not record source coverage, despite the required audit-manifest scope including source coverage.
highConfidenceFindings.action: Add per-group or per-question source counts to the manifest, while preserving the existing question schema.

reviewNotes: The repeated-stem finding is distinct from exact duplicate-text validation: the text differs only by mechanically substituted context prefixes.
The option-length result is an aggregate review signal, not a directive to rewrite every strictly-longest correct option.
The source findings concern traceability and catalog specificity; they do not establish that the keyed content is factually wrong.
